messages:
cora: heads up — noticed a sharp invoice spike for tenant `redwood-test` in today's nightly preview. looks like a bunch of mixed-modality requests got double-counted.
sam: ugh. any quick repro or logs?
cora: yes, pulled a sample from ingest. the client is batching a generation + embeddings call in one request. our metering consumer treats each modality as separate 'route' when route_tag is missing, then fanouts to two aggregators.
cora: snippet from the proxy log:
```
2026-03-22T22:03:11Z INFO request_id=abc123 tenant=redwood-test payload=[{type:generation, model:gpt-4-redwood},{type:embedding, model:embed-large}]
2026-03-22T22:03:11Z INFO meter_event route_id=null tokens=412 event_id=evt_987
2026-03-22T22:03:11Z INFO meter_event route_id=null tokens=412 event_id=evt_987 (fanout->embedding-agg)
```
mike: wait — why tokens doubled? same event_id
anya: looks like fanout -> when route_id is null we replicate into modality-specific aggregators. previous assumption: downstream dedupe by event_id, but event_id mutated during transport (we add modality suffix for routing) so dedupe missed.
sam: can you paste the mapper code that tags the event_id? IIRC we append `-mod` in the sidecar.
cora: here:
```
# ingest-sidecar pseudo
if not event.route_id:
  for mod in request.modalities:
    out = event.copy()
    out.event_id = f"{event.event_id}-{mod}"
    publish(mod + "-meter", out)
```
sam: ohhh. so dedupe key changed. billing pipeline dedupe uses original event_id only. when we mutate it, both copies pass dedupe and count twice.
oliver: billing-bot just posted an automated alert for tenant anomaly: :rotating_light:
billing-bot: WARNING tenant=redwood-test invoice_preview_delta=+$1,200 anomaly_score=0.97 link=https://console/redwood/invoices/preview/redwood-test
anya: this ties to the canary rollout of clientlib v2 that batches mixed modalities by default. rollout flag is `metering.v2_batching` and it's at 12%.
mike: options:
- change sidecar to keep event_id canonical and attach modality metadata separately (preferred)
- change dedupe to use trace fingerprint (more invasive)
- stop fanout and rework aggregator to accept multimodal payloads (big change)
sam: can we hotfix sidecar to not mutate event_id? minimal risk.
cora: agree. i'll open PR and add a toggle so we can revert. also we should add a consumer-level safety: dedupe on (event_id OR event_id prefix before dash).
anya: and console UX — the invoice preview should surface modality attribution so customers see which modality drove cost. current dashboard only shows total tokens per route.
oliver: i'll add a small dashboard card: `tokens_by_modality` under tenant view. low effort.
sam: who owns telemetry PROD query to quantify how many tenants hit this? cora, can you run a BigQuery-ish query for events where event_id like '%-%' and route_id is null and created between 2026-03-22T00:00 and now?
cora: running now... returns ~1.4k events across 28 tenants, top affected: redwood-test (48 events) and acme-sandbox (21).
mike: timeline: PR -> canary sidecar change -> monitor invoice_preview diffs. if no regressions, rollout full. target: hotfix today.
anya: product note: pause clientlib v2 rollout until we confirm attribution correctness. I'll flip the feature flag to 0% for now.
sam: assign: cora -> PR and BQ query, mike -> review and deploy, oliver -> dashboard card, anya -> flip flag and notify customers if needed. tagging @billing-team for FYI.
cora: PR opened: https://git/redwood/ingest/PR/4567 — changes: keep event_id stable; add `modality` field on published events. tests added.
mike: reviewed, left one comment about kafka schema bump. once fixed i'll merge.
anya: thanks all. after merge we'll run a backfill dedupe job for the last 24h and recompute previews for affected tenants.
oliver: noted. will track in the dashboard card and post a follow-up when previews update. :thumbsup:
sam: nice catch. saved customers from worse billing surprises.
cora: thanks — will post follow-up once backfill finishes.
